bias.zh: 看空 · 放量反弹，受阻于 $497 下方

read.en: AMD rose 3.7% on Nov 3 to $483.90, trading between $473.54 and $497.35 on volume 1.5 times the 20-day average. It is below the falling 5-day ($520.1), 10-day ($526.9) and 30-day ($577.0) and the rising 100-day ($529.2), and above the rising 200-day ($412.9). MACD has been below its signal since Oct 9 and below zero, histogram widening; Parabolic SAR has been bearish since Oct 30 ($572.99), and RSI is 38.
read.zh: AMD 11月3日上涨 3.7%，收于 $483.90，盘中区间 $473.54–497.35，成交量为 20 日均量的 1.5 倍。股价位于下行的 5 日（$520.1）、10 日（$526.9）和 30 日均线（$577.0）以及上行的 100 日均线（$529.2）下方，高于上行的 200 日均线（$412.9）。MACD 自 10月9日起位于信号线下方且在零轴之下，柱状图扩大；抛物线 SAR 自 10月30日起看空（$572.99），RSI 为 38。

read.en: The high of $497.35 tested the $492.2–502.6 broken support and faded; the Nov 2 low of $466.07 held. Resistance is $492.2–502.6, then $512.8–520.4 (Nov 2 and Oct 30 highs, 5-day) and $526.9–529.2 (10 and 100-day). Support is $466.1–473.5 (Nov 2 and Nov 3 lows), then $460.2–463.2 and $440.5–451. A close above $502.6 would target $513–520; below $466, $460–463.

r.en: Oct 30 low $492.2; Nov 3 high $497.35; Oct 22 low $502.6
